# Tony's Auto Repairs & Sales

> Neighborhood auto repair shop, tire seller and used car lot on Hull Street Rd in Southside Richmond, Virginia. Motto: "We do it all" / "Hacemos de todo." Free estimates and free brake inspection. English and Spanish.

## Contact
- Name: Tony's Auto Repairs & Sales (legal: Tony's Auto Repairs & Sales LLC; also known as Tony's Auto Repair)
- Address: 5258 Hull Street Rd, Richmond, VA 23224 (Hull Street corridor, Southside Richmond)
- Phone: (804) 233-5599 (call or text)
- Website: https://tonysautorva.com/ (Spanish: https://tonysautorva.com/es/)
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/hullstreettony/
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=5258+Hull+Street+Rd%2C+Richmond%2C+VA+23224
- Languages: English and Spanish
- In business since: 2010

## Hours
- Open 7 days a week (per the shop's business card). Hours vary; call (804) 233-5599 to confirm today's hours.

## Services
- General auto repair ("we do it all") with free estimates
- Brakes, including a free brake inspection
- Check-engine light diagnostics (ask about a free check-engine scan)
- New and used tires, "the best prices on new and used tires"
- Suspension repair and lowering installs
- Used cars for sale (inventory changes; call or text for what is on the lot)

## Prices
- Estimates: free
- Brake inspection: free
- Tires: price depends on size and new vs. used; call with your tire size for a quote
- Repairs: quoted with a free estimate before work begins

## How to book
- Call (804) 233-5599, text the same number, or send the contact form at https://tonysautorva.com/contact.html

## Reviews
- Google rating 4.3 from 116 reviews

## FAQ
- Are you open on weekends? The card says open 7 days a week; call to confirm today's hours.
- Are estimates free? Yes.
- Is the brake inspection free? Yes.
- Do you sell used tires? Yes, new and used. Call with your tire size.
- Do you have cars for sale? Yes. Call or text (804) 233-5599 for current inventory; no inventory is posted online.
- Do you speak Spanish? Yes; the business card is in Spanish and the website has a full Spanish version.
- Where do I park? In the lot in front of the shop at 5258 Hull Street Rd.
